description.fun: Volcanion is a living steam engine: an organ inside it boils the water it takes in, and it blasts the steam from the cannon-like arms on its back with enough pressure to blow away mountains, then vanishes into the fog. People in Kalos and elsewhere worship it as a 'nation-building Pokémon' because its blasts reshape the land for people to live on. No other Pokémon is Fire and Water.
description.guide: Volcanion is a Fire- and Water-type Mythical Pokémon from Kalos, the only Pokémon with that type combination. It turns water into high-pressure steam and fires it from the arms on its back, hiding in the fog it creates. It lives in mountains people don't visit and is revered for reshaping the land.
description.tagline: A steam-cannon lion that blasts mountains out of its way
